property.name: Availability Topic
property.description: Topic to subscribe for device availability (optional)

property.name: Availability Topic Value
property.description: Raw value received from the availability topic

property.name: Availability Value Path
property.description: JSONPath to extract availability value (e.g., "$.status"). Leave empty to use raw payload.

property.name: Availability Value Path Result
property.description: Result of JSONPath extraction for availability

property.name: Availability Status
property.description: Current availability status

property.name: Payload Available
property.description: Payload that indicates device is available (if only this is set, other values mean unavailable)

property.name: Payload Not Available
property.description: Payload that indicates device is not available (if only this is set, other values mean available)

property.name: Capabilities
property.description: Abilities this fan has, derived from the topics (or JSON keys) that are filled in

property.name: Fan State
property.description: Current state as reported to Control4

property.name: Discovered Device
property.description: Pick a Tasmota iFan found by the MQTT Broker; every setting below is filled in and follows the device. (Manual) leaves the settings as typed.

property.name: Device Notes
property.description: Settings on the discovered device that should change for this fan to work well

property.name: Payload Mode
property.description: Separate Topics: one topic per ability with plain values (Tasmota, ESPHome, Shelly command topics). JSON: one state topic and one command topic carrying a JSON object (Zigbee2MQTT, Home Assistant JSON).

property.name: JSON State Topic
property.description: Topic the fan publishes its JSON state on (e.g. zigbee2mqtt/bedroom_fan)

property.name: JSON Command Topic
property.description: Topic to publish JSON commands to (e.g. zigbee2mqtt/bedroom_fan/set)

property.name: State Request Topic
property.description: Optional. Topic that asks the device for its full state, sent when the broker connects and when the device comes online (Tasmota: cmnd/<topic>/STATE)

property.name: State Request Payload
property.description: Payload sent with the state request. Empty for Tasmota.

property.name: Optimistic
property.description: Report commanded state immediately instead of waiting for the device (Auto: yes when no state topic is set)

property.name: QoS
property.description: MQTT Quality of Service level for subscriptions and commands

property.name: Retain
property.description: Retain command messages on the broker

property.name: On Speed
property.description: Speed the fan runs at when turned on: the preset chosen in Control4 (highest until one is chosen), or the speed it last ran at

property.name: Power State Topic
property.description: Topic reporting on/off state (e.g. stat/tasmota_fan/POWER). Optional when the speed topic also reports off.

property.name: Power Value Path
property.description: JSONPath to the on/off value when the payload is JSON (e.g. "$.POWER"). Leave empty to use the raw payload.

property.name: Power Command Topic
property.description: Topic to publish on/off commands to (e.g. cmnd/tasmota_fan/POWER)

property.name: State Key
property.description: JSON key (or JSONPath) holding the on/off state

property.name: State On
property.description: Value that means ON (if only this is set, other values mean OFF)

property.name: State Off
property.description: Value that means OFF (if only this is set, other values mean ON)

property.name: Payload On
property.description: Value to send to turn the fan on

property.name: Payload Off
property.description: Value to send to turn the fan off

property.name: Speed State Topic
property.description: Topic reporting the speed. Filling in a speed topic gives the fan speeds.

property.name: Speed Value Path
property.description: JSONPath to the speed value (e.g. "$.FanSpeed" for Tasmota stat/x/RESULT)

property.name: Speed Command Topic
property.description: Topic to publish speeds to (e.g. cmnd/tasmota_fan/FanSpeed)

property.name: Speed Key
property.description: JSON key for the speed (e.g. "fan_mode"). Filling it in gives the fan speeds.

property.name: Speed Count
property.description: Number of speeds when Speed Values is empty; the device values are then 1 to this number

property.name: Speed Values
property.description: Device values for each speed, slowest first, comma separated (e.g. "low,medium,high" or "33,66,100"). The number of values is the speed count. Numbers reported in between go to the nearest speed.

property.name: Speed Off Value
property.description: Optional. Speed value that means off (e.g. "0" for Tasmota FanSpeed, "off" for Zigbee2MQTT fan_mode). With it the speed topic also turns the fan off.

property.name: Speed Mapping
property.description: Control4 always shows 6 speed levels. Spread: the top speed is level 6 (3 speeds: levels 2, 4, 6). Levels 1 to N: speed 1 is level 1; levels above the speed count run the top speed.

property.name: Direction State Topic
property.description: Topic reporting the direction. Filling in a direction topic lets Control4 reverse the fan.

property.name: Direction Value Path
property.description: JSONPath to the direction value (e.g. "$.direction")

property.name: Direction Command Topic
property.description: Topic to publish the direction to

property.name: Direction Key
property.description: JSON key for the direction (e.g. "direction")

property.name: Direction Forward
property.description: Value that means forward (sent and received)

property.name: Direction Reverse
property.description: Value that means reverse (sent and received)

property.name: On Button LED When On
property.description: LED color of keypad buttons bound to the On Button Link while the fan is on

property.name: On Button LED When Off
property.description: LED color of keypad buttons bound to the On Button Link while the fan is off

property.name: Off Button LED When On
property.description: LED color of keypad buttons bound to the Off Button Link while the fan is on

property.name: Off Button LED When Off
property.description: LED color of keypad buttons bound to the Off Button Link while the fan is off

property.name: Toggle Button LED When On
property.description: LED color of keypad buttons bound to the Toggle Button Link while the fan is on

property.name: Toggle Button LED When Off
property.description: LED color of keypad buttons bound to the Toggle Button Link while the fan is off

property.name: Speed Button LED When On
property.description: LED color of keypad buttons bound to the Speed Up, Speed Down and Toggle Direction Button Links while the fan is on

property.name: Speed Button LED When Off
property.description: LED color of keypad buttons bound to the Speed Up, Speed Down and Toggle Direction Button Links while the fan is off
